name: pypdfform-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is PyPDFForm, a Python library and command line tool for working with PDF
forms: it inspects form fields (JSON schema, current data, sample data, field locations), fills text
fields, checkboxes, radio button groups, dropdowns, signature and image fields, changes field styling
and behavior, creates new form fields, draws raw elements, adds annotations, embeds JavaScript, and
offers utilities such as blank pages, page extraction, merging and PDF version changes.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the PyPDFForm package under PyPDFForm/ (the Python library and its `pypdfform` command line interface), together with README.md, the user-guide pages docs/index.md, docs/install.md, docs/basic.md, docs/coordinate.md, docs/font.md, docs/prepare.md, docs/inspect.md, docs/fill.md, docs/style.md, docs/annotation.md, docs/acro_js.md, docs/draw.md and docs/utils.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

T
